text: ὁ ὑπερβρέφος οὐ φοβεῖται. ὁ ὑπερβρέφος λαμβάνει τὸν μέγαν λίθον.
objects: a bright red leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
a white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit

positioning: Hyperbrephos bends down and lifts the massive boulder with superhuman strength, showing no strain
Glaux watches in amazement, still holding both balls
Lukos's angry expression begins to change to concern as he sees the huge rock
